shapeSummary: A 22.1 x 19.9 x 1.0 mm rectangular PCB lies in the XY plane at the back (Z from -8.2 to -7.2). A solid 16 mm diameter cylinder, the ultrasonic transducer, extends from the PCB along +Z to Z=8.2. The cylinder is slightly right of center and low on the board. One 3.1 mm through hole sits near the upper-left corner of the PCB. The overall bounds are 22.1 x 19.9 x 16.4 mm, with the bottom at Y=0 and X and Z centered.
warnings: The PCB thickness (1.0 mm), transducer diameter (16 mm) and transducer center offset (x=1.5, y=8.5) are estimated from image proportions.
The mounting-hole position was moved to the top-left corner (x=-7.4, y=16.5) because the analysis coordinates were inconsistent with the visible location. Its diameter is estimated.
The 7 solder pads, SMD components, and the transducer's grille slots and openings are omitted as uncertain or decorative. The transducer is modeled as a solid cylinder.
